title: 15 Best OpenClaw Skills in 2026 (Tested and Ranked)
summary: The 15 best OpenClaw skills available on ClaWHub in 2026 — tested across 200+ hours of real use for daily briefings, research, code review, and business automation.
body_markdown: Verified skills (badge on ClaWHub) have been reviewed by the OpenClaw team. Community skills haven't. Before installing a community skill, check: is the code public? When was it last updated? Does it request permissions it doesn't need? For skills that access email or messages, stick to verified skills. For read-only tools like weather, community skills are lower risk.
